shortDescription: Manage users/schemas in an Oracle database

options.name: authentication_type
options.description: The type of authentication for the user

options.name: container
options.description: To specify the CONTAINER clause, you must be connected to a multitenant container database

options.name: default_tablespace
options.description: The default tablespace for the new schema. The tablespace must exist

options.name: default_temp_tablespace
options.description: The default tablespace for the new schema. The tablespace must exist

options.name: expired
options.description: Expire password If not specified for a new user, Oracle default will be used.

options.name: external_name
options.description: The external name (e.g. certificate DN or Kerberos principal) for an externally identified user, i.e. C(IDENTIFIED EXTERNALLY AS '<external_name>'). Only valid with I(authentication_type=external). Omit it to use the bare C(IDENTIFIED EXTERNALLY) form (an existing external name is then cleared).

options.name: locked
options.description: Lock or unlock account. If not specified for a new user, Oracle default will be used.

options.name: schema
options.description: The schema that you want to manage

options.name: schema_password
options.description: The password for the new schema. i.e '..identified by password'

options.name: schema_password_hash
options.description: The password hash for the new schema. i.e '..identified by values "XXXXXXX"'

options.name: state
options.description: Whether the user should exist. Absent removes the user (cascade)
